outcome: An agent task can inspect injected context and missing required information before it starts, returns structured feedback after it runs, and skill-creator can draft gated agile skills that stay disabled until the validator records a pass
acceptance: inspecting an agent task injects WorkItem context, parent/child tree, milestone, acceptance criteria, project tech profile, source documents, prior agent feedback, tool permissions, and checks
missing required information is listed before the task starts
start is blocked while required information is missing
a completed agent run returns structured feedback, assumptions, open questions, evidence references, and next actions
skill-creator drafts a skill from an agile template without enabling it for agent execution

the template catalog covers requirement intake, analysis, story splitting, acceptance criteria, prioritization, sprint planning, UX review, architecture, implementation planning, code review, test design, QA verification, security review, release, documentation, and retrospective analysis
validating a draft records the result in agent_skill_validations
an invalid or unvalidated draft cannot be enabled for agent execution
customers cannot inspect agent task context or create, validate, or enable skill drafts
inScope: task context inspect and missing-input gate
skill-creator drafts, validator, and enable gate
outOfScope: auto-enabling drafted skills as live runtime agents
assumptions: built-in MKT and coding skills remain the live agent runtime set
C6 agent feedback accept/reject remains a separate control
